# Clint Balbontin: Digital Marketing Specialist (Philippines)

> Digital marketing specialist based in the Philippines (GMT+8), working remotely with clients in Australia, the UK, Europe, and the US since 2015. Social media and content, email and CRM automation (Klaviyo, GoHighLevel, MailChimp), websites, funnels, SEO, and brand design. 11+ years, 300+ completed projects, creative lead on 200+ custom real estate websites.

## Services
- [Social Media & Content](https://clintbalbontin.com/services/social-media-content): strategy, content design, captions, short video, scheduling for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn
- [Email & CRM Automation](https://clintbalbontin.com/services/email-crm-automation): Klaviyo flows and campaigns, GoHighLevel funnels, pipelines, calendars, workflows, MailChimp
- [Websites, Funnels & SEO](https://clintbalbontin.com/services/websites-funnels-seo): website design, WordPress and GoHighLevel builds, technical SEO, schema, GA4 and Google Tag Manager
- [Creative & Brand](https://clintbalbontin.com/services/creative-brand): logo and brand identity, annual reports, slide decks, print, event and aerial photography

## Case studies
- [Meta was missing half the revenue](https://clintbalbontin.com/work/funnel-revenue-tracking): Meta reported $1,215 in purchase value (May to July 2026); the GoHighLevel funnel recorded $2,476. July cost per purchase fell 59% from June. Account did not reach profit (true ROAS 0.64).
- [Klaviyo email for a DTC appliance brand](https://clintbalbontin.com/work/klaviyo-email-dtc-brand): Fritaire, April 2025 to July 2026. Five-email welcome series, seven recovery emails across browse, cart, and checkout flows.
- [Luxury real estate websites](https://clintbalbontin.com/work/luxury-real-estate-websites): creative lead on 200+ custom websites for North American agents and brokerages, 2021 to 2025.
- [Makati Business Club](https://clintbalbontin.com/work/makati-business-club): 2018 and 2019 annual reports, 2020 Annual Membership Meeting deck, Business Matters social series, event photography.
- [Philippine Department of Tourism](https://clintbalbontin.com/work/philippine-tourism-campaign): 2015 results campaign graphics under "It's More Fun in the Philippines".
